senses.gloss: Luz, in Palestine, identical with, or near, Bethel.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69:8">Gen. R. s. 69</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00226">next w.</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: Luz, in the land of the Hittites (Jud. I, 26), supposed to be Lizan in Kurdistan (v. Neub. Géogr., p. 394), a place, mentioned in the Talmud as still existing, from which the purple blue (תכלת) was imported.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 12a:6">Snh. 12ᵃ</cite> (in a secret letter) <he>דברים הנעשים בל׳</he> (not <he>הנעשה</he>) things manufactured in Luz (<cite ref="V00547"><he>תכלת</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Sotah 46b:11">Sot. 46ᵇ</cite> (ref. to Jud. l. c.) <he>היא ל׳ שצובעין וכ׳</he> it is that Luz where they dye purple blue, which Sennaherib left undisturbed, and Nebucadnezar did not destroy, and where the angel of death has no permission to enter &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69:8">Gen. R. s. 69</cite> (applied to <cite ref="Genesis 28:19">Gen. XXVIII, 19</cite>).
